proposals.before: On guichou Khitan envoys led by Nako Meri came with tribute to claim Tu Nei's bones after his beheading at the north market.
proposals.after: On guichou Khitan envoys led by Nako Meri came with tribute claiming to take Tu Nei's bones, and they were beheaded at the north market.
proposals.reason: Chinese 並斬於北市 follows the envoy clause; the envoys were beheaded, not a restatement of Tu Nei's earlier death.

proposals.before: On renchen Chen Gao became Wuxing commissioner and Zhai Zhang Weisai commissioner.
proposals.after: On dinghai Chen Gao became Wuxing commissioner and Zhai Zhang Weisai commissioner.
proposals.reason: Chinese date is 丁亥 (dinghai), not renchen; literal also wrongly says renchen.

proposals.before: On renchen, Feng prefecture Wuxing Army acting regent Chen Gao was made Wuxing Army military commissioner; Xin prefecture Weisai Army acting regent Zhai Zhang was made Weisai Army military commissioner.
proposals.after: On dinghai, Feng prefecture Wuxing Army acting regent Chen Gao was made Wuxing Army military commissioner; Xin prefecture Weisai Army acting regent Zhai Zhang was made Weisai Army military commissioner.
proposals.reason: Chinese 丁亥 is dinghai; both English fields wrongly use renchen.

proposals.before: On jiachen Feng Dao became southern suburban chief ritualist; Lu Zhi of War, ritualist; Xu Guangyi, censor-in-chief, equipage master; Yao Yan of War, halberd master; Congrong of Henan, bridge and relay master; Zhang Zunhui, guest commissioner and Court of the Imperial Clan director, repair and regalia master.
proposals.after: On jiachen Feng Dao became southern suburban chief ritualist; Lu Zhi of War, ritualist; Xu Guangyi, censor-in-chief, equipage master; Yao Hui of War, halberd master; Congrong of Henan, bridge and relay master; Zhang Zunhui, guest commissioner and Court of the Imperial Clan director, repair and regalia master.
proposals.reason: 姚顗 was already rendered Yao Hui in s0066; Yao Yan is an inconsistent romanization of the same name.

proposals.before: On guiwei Yu Qiao, secretariat vice director, was matched to a Zhenwu long exile and barred forever—Zhao Feng's false memorial.
proposals.after: On guiwei Yu Qiao, secretariat vice director, was sentenced to long exile as a commoner at Zhenwu and barred from office forever—Zhao Feng's false memorial.
proposals.reason: 「配…長流百姓」means sentencing to long exile as a commoner; “matched to a Zhenwu long exile” is unnatural and obscures the legal meaning.

proposals.before: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》 says supervising compiler Zhao Feng and compilers Zhang Zhaoyuan and Lü Xianxiu each received silks, silver vessels, and the like.)〉
proposals.after: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》 says supervising compiler Zhao Feng and compilers Zhang Zhaoyuan and Lü Xianxiu each received silks, silver vessels, and the like.)
proposals.reason: Trailing fullwidth corner bracket 〉 is a fused punctuation artifact not present as a meaningful closer in the English translation.

decisions.reason: 並斬於北市 follows the envoy arrival and pretext clause, so the envoys (捺括梅裏等) are the ones beheaded; the before text wrongly treats 斬 as Tu Nei's earlier death.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 契丹遣捺括梅裏等來朝貢，稱取禿餒等骸骨，並斬於北市

decisions.reason: The unit opens 丁亥 (dinghai); renchen is the following day 壬辰 in s0062, so the idiomatic date must be corrected.
Literal likewise misreads 丁亥 as renchen; dinghai matches the Chinese day name.

decisions.after: On jiachen Feng Dao became southern suburban chief ritualist; Lu Zhi of War, ritualist; Xu Guangyi, censor-in-chief, equipage master; Yao Yi of War, halberd master; Congrong of Henan, bridge and relay master; Zhang Zunhui, guest commissioner and Court of the Imperial Clan director, repair and regalia master.
decisions.reason: 姚顗 is Yao Yi (顗 = yǐ); Yao Yan is wrong, and the proposed Yao Hui is also an incorrect romanization of the same graph.
配振武長流百姓 is a legal sentence to long exile as a commoner at Zhenwu, and 永不齒任 bars office forever; the before phrasing obscures both.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 配振武長流百姓，永不齒任

decisions.reason: The trailing 〉 is residue from the Chinese annotation brackets 〈…〉 and is not part of the English gloss.
Same fused trailing 〉 artifact should be dropped from the literal English field.

claimRevisions.reason: Revised r0004 restores 顗 as Yi; the name claim's English Yao Yan was produced by the bad romanization and must become Yao Yi.
